name: Claude Caches
description: Live Claude Code sessions and how long each one's prompt cache has left, in a panel and in the status bar. Needs the cache-countdown mod for Claude Code, from the same repository.

screenshots.alt: The Claude Caches panel: three live sessions with 2, 11 and 51 min of cache left in red, amber and green; two expired or no-data ones folded below.
screenshots.caption: Live sessions, the one that expires soonest on top

commands.title: Claude Caches: Go to the session expiring soonest
